sections.content: Grid creates two-dimensional layouts — rows AND columns — ideal for page skeletons: header/sidebar/main/footer in a few lines.
Define tracks with grid-template-columns/rows (fr units share space), place items with grid-column/row, and gap spaces everything.
Key points: 1fr = one share of free space, auto-fit/auto-fill make responsive grids without media queries, and grid areas name regions.
